Saajha Saajha believes in the dignity and potential of all parents and creates platforms for them to impact lives of children. We are working towards improving Foundational literacy and numeracy outcomes for children in the age group of 6-11 years through parental engagement. Bronze Certified 2023 80G 12A CSR-1 Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Geographies Served Programs Tech and Community Driven support to improve Foundational Literacy and Numeracy State Delhi States Delhi Saajha’s tools ensure children are able to use curated and targeted learning solutions to improve educational outcomes. We have identified two key enablers for this - teaching at the right level and parental involvement in learning. Through calls with parents, the child’s Hindi and Math levels are assessed by our team members through a standardized evaluation tool. The result of the assessment along with the level-appropriate content is then shared with the parent via the Chatbot. Apart from level-specific content, the families can access information about schools and connect with our team members, who are also parents from similar communities through the helpline to address any concerns they may have Thus, fostering a human-to-human relationship that focuses on providing solutions that remain culturally relevant for the families. Milestones & Track Record Saajha has made over 1.3 million calls to parents and triggered learning content 6.9 million times via WhatsApp to support children's education. --> --> Leadership Team Prashast Srivastava Director Abhishek Choudhary Chief Executive Officer Saransh Vaswani Founder Surabhi Bikhchandani Advisory Board Member Brijesh Aggarwal Advisory Board Member Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAVCS2348M Registration Number U80904DL2014NPL273093 CSR Form 1 CSR00000418 VO ID / Darpan ID DL/2017/0150866 --> 80G AAVCS2348MF20214 12A AAVCS2348ME20214 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Delhi, Delhi Since 2014 Demographies Served Women Children --> Impact Since 2014, Saajha has worked across 2000+ schools in Delhi, Maharashtra, Jharkhand and Karnataka, reaching over 100,000 parents through about 100 Saajhedars (parent champions). Vision and Mission Saajha's vision is to build a national level peer engagement platform of 100,000 School Management Committees across India. Its mission is to empower parents to improve children's learning outcomes. fields.description: Saajha works towards support for parents in education and community engagement in public primary schools, to ensure an effective collaboration between schools and the community thereby improving the learning outcomes. Saajha works towards strengthening strengthens the School Management Committees (SMCs), which are mandatory bodies comprising of elected parents, teachers and representatives of the community.
